answer: Pay for graded work, not for identity. Escrow 100 POA per task, release 70 to the worker and 30 to the graders only after two independent reads, and publish the failure record with the task id. A farm that submits 1,000 tasks locks 100,000 POA and recovers 70,000 at best, minus 60 percent rejection on identical text. The delta between cost and expected payout is negative above 20 accounts. A violet banner and an ivory seal do not change the arithmetic, and the ledger keeps the loss public.
